# ALFA Group

> ALFA Group is a steadily growing multi-division company supporting major industries across the Middle East. Operating as a reliable subcontractor from Dammam, Saudi Arabia, ALFA delivers integrated Engineering, Procurement, Fabrication & Construction (EPFC) solutions across the Oil & Gas, Renewable Energy, Power & Utilities, Marine & Offshore, Defense, Petrochemical, Construction, Industrial and Commercial sectors.

ALFA Group operates through specialized divisions — Marine & Offshore, Construction, Fabrication & Machining, Trading, ICT, Facility Management, and Joinery — backed by ISO certifications and a commitment to quality, safety, and on-time delivery.

Contact: info@alfamarinesa.com · +966 13 805 2528 · Prince Muhammad Ibn Saud District, Dammam, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

- [Sustainability](https://alfa-website-chi.vercel.app/sustainability): Environmental responsibility, HSE policy, quality assurance, and ethics & compliance.

- [Get In Touch](https://alfa-website-chi.vercel.app/get-in-touch): Contact form, commercial inquiries, careers, supplier registration, and whistleblowing.

## Divisions

- [Marine & Offshore](https://alfa-website-chi.vercel.app/what-we-do#marine-offshore): Modular buildings, living quarters, and offshore technical services to ABS/DNV standards.
- [Construction](https://alfa-website-chi.vercel.app/what-we-do#construction): Civil, structural, and MEP construction solutions.
- [Fabrication & Machining](https://alfa-website-chi.vercel.app/what-we-do#fabrication-machining): Specialized steel fabrication and CNC machining.
- [Trading](https://alfa-website-chi.vercel.app/what-we-do#trading): Procurement, trading, and industrial supplies.
- [ICT](https://alfa-website-chi.vercel.app/what-we-do#ict): ICT & ELV systems, structured cabling, and smart solutions.
- [Facility Management](https://alfa-website-chi.vercel.app/what-we-do#facility-management): Facility management and maintenance.
- [Joinery](https://alfa-website-chi.vercel.app/what-we-do#joinery): Joinery works and custom fit-outs.
